ns2:course.label: Regulation of Metabolism
ns2:course.description: Biochemical and molecular regulatory mechanisms of macronutrient metabolism under various physiological conditions in mammalian species, including humans. Same as ANSC 521 and FSHN 511. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: MCB 450, MCB 244, MCB 246 and FSHN 426/ANSC 520 (or equivalent courses in biochemistry, physiology and nutrition). Second year graduate standing or above, or consent of instructor.
